text: せんじょう　パーティは　もう　おわった　ころ　じゃないかな

structure.jp: せんじょう　パーティは
もう　おわった　ころ
structure.en: about the time it has already ended

patterns.name: 〜じゃないかな
patterns.span: ころ　じゃないかな
patterns.explanation: じゃないかな at the end is a soft way of giving your guess: 'isn't it, I think'. ころ じゃないかな = 'it's probably about that time'.

patterns.name: 〜ころ
patterns.explanation: ころ after a verb means 'around the time when' that happens. おわった ころ = 'about the time it has finished'.
